prompts: Create a production game sprite WALK ANIMATION SHEET of ONLY the silver-haired woman expedition captain from the FIRST ROW of reference. EXACT 4 columns by 4 rows, evenly spaced identical square cells, all characters same scale, full body with comfortable margins. In EACH row, columns are consecutive four walk-cycle phases: left-foot-forward/right-arm-forward contact; passing pose with right leg lifting, left leg straight; right-foot-forward/left-arm-forward contact; passing pose with left leg lifting, right leg straight. Distinct anatomically believable leg articulation and gentle opposite arm swing, cape trailing slightly. One character per cell, sixteen sprites total. Every frame same head height, same body proportions, torso centered horizontally, feet baseline near bottom with room, no cropping. Use real alpha, not checkerboard background. This is an animation game asset, not a concept collage. Do not add any of the other three characters.

Revise this production RPG walk-cycle sheet. Preserve the exact silver-haired space captain design and 4x4 layout. Correct two defects: remove the baked checkerboard completely, output genuine transparent alpha. NO checkerboard pixels. Also make each row an actual four-frame alternating walk: column 1 LEFT leg forward, column 2 BOTH feet close together passing under torso, column 3 RIGHT leg forward, column 4 BOTH feet close together passing under torso with opposite knee lifted. Every figure must stand centered at the horizontal middle of its equal quarter-width cell, with equal head-to-ground height, consistent bottom foot pivot 90% down each quarter-height cell.
